title: The King Who Invited the Missionaries
sources: Dictionary of African Christian Biography, 'A History of Christianity in Uganda' — Stanley's 1875 visit; CMS party reaches Rubaga 30 June 1877; White Fathers 17 February 1879
Church of Uganda, 'About Us' — Stanley met Muteesa in April 1875; appeal published in the Daily Telegraph 15 November 1875
Tucker of Uganda (A. P. Shepherd, 1929) — eight missionaries sail 27 April 1876; Smith and Wilson reach Mengo 30 June 1877; Smith and O'Neill killed at Ukerewe
New Vision, 'Muteesa writes to the Queen' — published appeal text; £5,000 donations; CMS decision eight days later
Apolo Kaggwa, The Kings of Buganda — Muteesa I's reign, 1856–1884
